Subjective symptoms, denoted as C, are each scored by the subject or caregiver using a numeric rating scale (NRS) where \"0\" is no itch (or no sleeplessness) and \"10\" is the worst imaginable itch (or sleeplessness). These scores are added to give 'C' (maximum of 20). The SCORAD for an individual is calculated by the formula: A/5 + 7B/2 + C (can range from 0 to 103). Each dimension has 5 response levels: 1=no problems, 2=slight problems, 3=moderate problems, 4=severe problems and 5=extreme problems. EQ-5D-5L health status index score range between 0 to 1.
